---
params:
  title: "Presentation Title"
  subtitle: "Subtitle or context"
  presenter: "Presenter Name"
  event: "Conference · Date"

format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, custom.scss]
    slide-number: true
    progress: true
    transition: slide
    background-transition: fade
    highlight-style: github
    code-overflow: wrap
    fig-align: center
    footer: "Circadia Lab · circadia-lab.uk · github.com/circadia-bio"
    logo: assets/circadia_logo.png
    width: 1280
    height: 720
---

```{=html}
<section data-background-image="assets/cover.png"
         data-background-size="cover"
         data-background-position="center"
         data-state="hide-footer">
  <div style="
    position: absolute;
    left: 560px; top: 130px;
    width: 720px; height: 420px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-end;
    text-align: right;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-right: 0;
  ">
    <h1 style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:2.1em; font-weight:500; color:#004474; line-height:1.1; margin:0 0 0.3em;">`r params$title`</h1>
    <p style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:1.05em; color:#1B6799; margin:0 0 0.6em;">`r params$subtitle`</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:0.85em; color:#FC544A; margin:0 0 0.2em;">`r params$presenter`</p>
    <p style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-size:0.72em; color:#1B6799; margin:0;">`r params$event`</p>
  </div>
</section>
```
